notes.title: Update 1.1 released
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

I have just released update 1.1 for VR Squash 2017 which contains:

    New game mode – TimeAttack – play against an opponent for two minutes, only the points you scored matters! This new playmode includes global Steam leaderboard integration so you can compete against others!
    Freestyle mode updates – Added leaderboard implementation (most consequent front wall hits is now counted and listed on a Steam leaderboard) also includes additional physics improvement in Freestyle mode
    Ball physics improvement – For adding more realism the ball bouncing has been improved

Other small updates and bugfixes: music on Freestyle and TimeAttack modes, achievement bug patch, minor general physics update

Stay tuned for additional updates soon!
